I've corrected the Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date in the shared brain and confirmed it to Ilse in a thread reply on their #north-random message.

- **Brain update:** I withdrew the old fact that said the renewal was 25 November, which Ilse posted in #north-team earlier today. I saved a new fact that says the next renewal is 10 June, with Ilse's #north-random correction recorded as the source. Recall showed no other saved fact that repeats the old date.
- **Year:** Ilse didn't give a year. Their message was sent on 2026-10-14, after 10 June 2026, so I saved it as "presumably 10 June 2027" and asked them to say if that's wrong.
- **Still uncorrected:** my reply on Ilse's original #north-team message still says 25 November. They said no action was needed, so I left it.
- **Who could see the reply:** a renewal date is an account detail, not a finance figure. My reply repeats only what Ilse wrote in #north-random, so posting it there was fine, even though June Osei-Lark is in that channel but not in #north-team.
